row.title: Kernel 9.0.0 is one self-contained file bound to JSON registries
row.body: doctrine/kernel-9.0.0.md embeds registries, procedures, ledger and hook and refers to no other file; kernel9 --check fails on a URL or repo path in it and on drift from the registries.
